scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:init: export MYSQL_PWD="${DB_ADMIN_PASSWORD:?Set DB_ADMIN_USER and DB_ADMIN_PASSWORD (admin account)}" && : "${DB_ADMIN_USER:?Set DB_ADMIN_USER}" && mysql -u "$DB_ADMIN_USER" -e 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS hospital_db; CREATE DATABASE hospital_db;' && mysql -u "$DB_ADMIN_USER" hospital_db < database/schema.sql && mysql -u "$DB_ADMIN_USER" hospital_db < database/triggers.sql && mysql -u "$DB_ADMIN_USER" hospital_db < database/seed.sql && mysql -u "$DB_ADMIN_USER" hospital_db < database/views.sql && mysql -u "$DB_ADMIN_USER" hospital_db < database/procedures.sql && mysql -u "$DB_ADMIN_USER" hospital_db < database/indexes.sql
scripts.start: cd server && npm start & cd client && npm run dev
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && cd server && NODE_ENV=production CLIENT_URL="${CLIENT_URL_PROD:-http://localhost:5000}" node server.js
scripts.demo:start: npm run build && cd server && NODE_ENV=production DB_NAME="${DEMO_DB_NAME:-hospital_demo}" CLIENT_URL="${CLIENT_URL_PROD:-http://localhost:5000}" node server.js
